products.name: Little Ocean Floor Grips
products.short: A little ocean under little feet.
products.description: Twenty little sea friends, in soft ocean blues, seafoam and sun-warmed coral. A coordinated floor-grip design for a cheerful bath-time space.
products.note: Wet-area grip and material testing are required before release. Not available to order until performance and surface compatibility are verified.

products.name: Little Ocean Wall Stickers
products.short: Make a splash. Tell a story.
products.description: A whale, a tiny submarine and a whole sea of friendly faces. Twenty coordinating illustrations bring a gentle underwater story to a child’s bathroom wall.
products.note: Bathroom adhesion, cleaning and material checks are required before release. Direct-spray shower use and final surface compatibility are not yet confirmed.
